title: Successor-degree connecting ladder for etale inverse-limit cohomology
statement: Let $I$ be a nonempty directed preordered set and let $D:I^{\mathrm{op}}\to\mathrm{Sch}$ be an inverse diagram of quasi-compact quasi-separated schemes [def-pc-scheme, def-weil-pbc-scheme-conventions] with affine transition morphisms. Let $(X,(f_i))$ be a limit cone [def-weil-pbc-category-colimit]. For each $i$, let $F_i$ be an abelian sheaf on $(D_i)_{\acute{e}t}$ [def-weil-pbc-abelian-etale-sheaves], with maps $\varphi_f:D(f^{\mathrm{op}})^{-1}F_i\to F_j$ for $f:i\to j$ [def-weil-pbc-inverse-image] satisfying the canonical inverse-image identity and composition laws. Let $G:I\to\operatorname{Ab}(X_{\acute{e}t})$ be identified objectwise with $f_i^{-1}F_i$ by isomorphisms, its arrows being inverse-image composition followed by pullback of $\varphi_f$. Let $L$ be a colimit cocone on $G$, with coprojections $\iota_i$. Fix $p\ge0$. Let $H:I\to\operatorname{Ab}$ have specified object isomorphisms $e_i:H_i\cong H^p(D_i,F_i)$ [def-weil-pbc-etale-cohomology] and arrows conjugate to $H^p(\varphi_f)\circ D(f^{\mathrm{op}})^*$ [def-weil-pbc-cohomology-pullback]. Let $B$ be a cocone on $H$ with an isomorphism $e:B_{\mathrm{pt}}\cong H^p(X,L_{\mathrm{pt}})$ such that, for every $i$, its leg $b_i$ satisfies $e\circ b_i=H^p(\iota_i)\circ f_i^*\circ e_i$, including the specified identification $G_i\cong f_i^{-1}F_i$. Take p=n+1 for n>=0. There exists a second compatible system of abelian sheaves R_i, with its inverse-image diagram GR, a colimit LR, a degree-n cohomology diagram HR and its canonical comparison cocone BR, with the same specified identity, composition and leg equations as above in degree n. There are additive homomorphisms delta:BR.pt -> B.pt and delta_i:HR_i -> H_i such that delta is surjective and b_i after delta_i equals delta after (BR)_i for each i. No stage-representative conclusion for BR is assumed or asserted.

source.place: Degree-zero case (09YN) and injective-system dimension shifting via 0EXZ and 0739; scheme passage via 09YQ, 0EYL and 04HR. Pages checked 2026-10-12.

proof.text: Apply the acyclic replacement to obtain FR, its compatible inverse-image diagram and colimit, a short exact sequence L -> E -> LR, its extension-class boundary d and the untransported stage boundaries beta. Apply the canonical degree-n cohomology diagram construction to FR, GR and LR to obtain HR and BR.

For x in H^(n+1)(L), the map to H^(n+1)(E) is zero because that group is subsingleton. Ext.covariant_sequence_exact₁ supplies y in H^n(LR) with y composed with the extension class equal to x. The boundary formula identifies d(y)=x, so d is surjective. Conjugate d by eBR.hom and eB.inv to obtain delta; epi_iff_surjective and isomorphism invariance prove surjectivity of delta.

Define delta_stage_i=eHR_i.hom followed by beta_i followed by eH_i.inv. Cancel eB.hom from the desired square. Rewrite hB and hBR, cancel inverse/hom pairs and reassociate. Precompose the untransported hbeta square by eHR_i.hom; this is the resulting equality. Package FR and all its supplied witnesses together with these maps. No inductive descent result is used.

proof_origin.place: Dimension shifting via Tag 0739: Lean proof of long-exact-sequence surjectivity and transport of connecting maps, from separate acyclic replacement and canonical diagram statements.

mathlib_searches.query: Degree zero etale cohomology of inverse limits of qcqs schemes and compatible injective coefficient systems
Compatible injective sheaf systems on inverse limits have a surjective connecting homomorphism from lower degree cokernel cohomology
mathlib_searches.results: Eight hits on local surjectivity, group-cohomology connecting maps and complex factorizations; no scheme inverse-system theorem. Loogle Sheaf.H finds H.equiv₀ and injective vanishing, but no limit descent.

mathlib_searches.query: colimit.*(Sheaf.H|cohomology)|cohomology.*colimit|connecting.*[Ll]adder in Mathlib Sites and AlgebraicGeometry; library inverse-limit descent
mathlib_searches.results: No Mathlib match; existing site connecting ladder has different site-system input, requiring scheme transport. Existing fixed-base class descent imposes torsion and does not accept varying sheaves.

mathlib_searches.verdict: Degree-zero identification and naturality only; none supplies inverse-limit sections or a compatible ladder.

mathlib_searches.query: Filtered systems of abelian etale sheaves admit compatible injective embeddings and dimension shifting maps on inverse limit schemes

theorem etale_limit_cohomology_connecting_ladder
    {I : Type u} [Preorder I] [IsDirected I (· ≤ ·)] [Nonempty I]
    (D : Iᵒᵖ ⥤ Scheme.{u}) (c : Cone D) (hc : IsLimit c)
    [∀ i : Iᵒᵖ, CompactSpace (D.obj i)] [∀ i : Iᵒᵖ, QuasiSeparatedSpace (D.obj i)]
    [∀ (i j : Iᵒᵖ) (f : i ⟶ j), IsAffineHom (D.map f)]
    (F : ∀ i : I, Sheaf (D.obj (op i)).smallEtaleTopology AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1})
    (φ : ∀ {i j : I} (f : i ⟶ j),
      (upperStar AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1} (D.map f.op)).obj (F i) ⟶ F j)
    (hidentity : ∀ i : I, φ (𝟙 i) =
      (eqToIso (congrArg (upperStar AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1}) (D.map_id (op i)))).hom.app
        (F i) ≫ (upperStarId AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1} (D.obj (op i))).hom.app (F i))
    (hcomposition : ∀ (i j k : I) (f : i ⟶ j) (g : j ⟶ k),
      φ (f ≫ g) =
        (upperStarComp AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1} (D.map g.op) (D.map f.op)
          (D.map (f ≫ g).op) (D.map_comp g.op f.op)).hom.app (F i) ≫
        (upperStar AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1} (D.map g.op)).map (φ f) ≫ φ g)
    (G : I ⥤ Sheaf c.pt.smallEtaleTopology AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1})
    (eG : ∀ i : I, G.obj i ≅
      (upperStar AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1} (c.π.app (op i))).obj (F i))
    (hG : ∀ (i j : I) (f : i ⟶ j), G.map f =
      (eG i).hom ≫
        (upperStarComp AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1} (c.π.app (op j)) (D.map f.op)
          (c.π.app (op i)) (c.w f.op).symm).hom.app (F i) ≫
        (upperStar AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1} (c.π.app (op j))).map (φ f) ≫ (eG j).inv)
    (L : Cocone G) (hL : IsColimit L) (n : ℕ)
    (H : I ⥤ AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1})
    (eH : ∀ i : I, H.obj i ≅ AddCommGrpCat.of (Sheaf.H (F i) (n + 1)))
    (hH : ∀ (i j : I) (f : i ⟶ j), H.map f =
      (eH i).hom ≫ AddCommGrpCat.ofHom (cohomologyMap (D.map f.op) (F i) (n + 1)) ≫
        AddCommGrpCat.ofHom (Sheaf.H.map (φ f) (n + 1)) ≫ (eH j).inv)
    (B : Cocone H) (eB : B.pt ≅ AddCommGrpCat.of (Sheaf.H L.pt (n + 1)))
    (hB : ∀ i : I, B.ι.app i ≫ eB.hom =
      (eH i).hom ≫ AddCommGrpCat.ofHom (cohomologyMap (c.π.app (op i)) (F i) (n + 1)) ≫
        AddCommGrpCat.ofHom (Sheaf.H.map ((eG i).inv ≫ L.ι.app i) (n + 1))) :
    ∃ (FR : ∀ i : I, Sheaf (D.obj (op i)).smallEtaleTopology AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1})
    (φR : ∀ {i j : I} (f : i ⟶ j),
      (upperStar AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1} (D.map f.op)).obj (FR i) ⟶ FR j)
    (hidentityR : ∀ i : I, φR (𝟙 i) =
      (eqToIso (congrArg (upperStar AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1}) (D.map_id (op i)))).hom.app
        (FR i) ≫ (upperStarId AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1} (D.obj (op i))).hom.app (FR i))
    (hcompositionR : ∀ (i j k : I) (f : i ⟶ j) (g : j ⟶ k),
      φR (f ≫ g) =
        (upperStarComp AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1} (D.map g.op) (D.map f.op)
          (D.map (f ≫ g).op) (D.map_comp g.op f.op)).hom.app (FR i) ≫
        (upperStar AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1} (D.map g.op)).map (φR f) ≫ φR g)
    (GR : I ⥤ Sheaf c.pt.smallEtaleTopology AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1})
    (eGR : ∀ i : I, GR.obj i ≅
      (upperStar AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1} (c.π.app (op i))).obj (FR i))
    (hGR : ∀ (i j : I) (f : i ⟶ j), GR.map f =
      (eGR i).hom ≫
        (upperStarComp AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1} (c.π.app (op j)) (D.map f.op)
          (c.π.app (op i)) (c.w f.op).symm).hom.app (FR i) ≫
        (upperStar AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1} (c.π.app (op j))).map (φR f) ≫ (eGR j).inv)
    (LR : Cocone GR) (hLR : IsColimit LR)
    (HR : I ⥤ AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1})
    (eHR : ∀ i : I, HR.obj i ≅ AddCommGrpCat.of (Sheaf.H (FR i) n))
    (hHR : ∀ (i j : I) (f : i ⟶ j), HR.map f =
      (eHR i).hom ≫ AddCommGrpCat.ofHom (cohomologyMap (D.map f.op) (FR i) n) ≫
        AddCommGrpCat.ofHom (Sheaf.H.map (φR f) n) ≫ (eHR j).inv)
    (BR : Cocone HR) (eBR : BR.pt ≅ AddCommGrpCat.of (Sheaf.H LR.pt n))
    (hBR : ∀ i : I, BR.ι.app i ≫ eBR.hom =
      (eHR i).hom ≫ AddCommGrpCat.ofHom (cohomologyMap (c.π.app (op i)) (FR i) n) ≫
        AddCommGrpCat.ofHom (Sheaf.H.map ((eGR i).inv ≫ LR.ι.app i) n)),
      ∃ (δ : BR.pt ⟶ B.pt) (δstage : ∀ i : I, HR.obj i ⟶ H.obj i),
        Function.Surjective δ.hom ∧
        (∀ i : I, δstage i ≫ B.ι.app i = BR.ι.app i ≫ δ)
